note: Owner rule: permissively licensed software only. `allowed` passes automatically. Anything else fails `npm run safety:licences` unless it has an exception below with a reason, an owner, a scope (package, version range, dev or production) and a review date. An exception with status "pending-review" is a classification waiting for the owner's decision, not a legal conclusion; it passes (with a warning) only until its reviewBy date. An exception with devOnly true fails if any matching package becomes a production dependency.

exceptions.scope: production (frontend): font files sent to browsers
exceptions.reason: SIL Open Font License: fonts may be used, bundled and redistributed with software; only selling the fonts on their own and reusing the reserved font names for modified fonts are restricted. Not on the permissive list because it is a font licence, not a software licence. Owner to confirm it fits the rule.

exceptions.scope: development only: CSS tool used by the build (Vite); not shipped
exceptions.reason: Weak, file-level copyleft: obligations apply only if we change and distribute lightningcss's own files. We only run it at build time. Owner to confirm a development-only MPL tool is acceptable.

exceptions.scope: development only (server): image library binaries pulled in by a development tool
exceptions.reason: Library copyleft on the libvips binaries; installed only as a development dependency, not part of the running server. Owner to confirm; if it ever becomes a production dependency this needs a real decision.

exceptions.scope: production (server): used by mammoth when reading Word files
exceptions.reason: The package says only "BSD", not which BSD licence. All common BSD variants are permissive, but the exact text should be checked in the package before this is accepted.
Boost Software License 1.0 is permissive; the package uses a non-standard identifier ("boost") so it is not matched automatically.
